philosophy: The page is the worktop a contact sheet is lying on. The sheet is film — dark rebate, light frames, sprocket perforations, edge printing — and the mark is a grease-pencil stroke along an edge. Many candidates surveyed cheaply, a few marked.
antiReference: The developer-tool brand this category ships: geometric sans wordmark, one abstract glyph, a single indigo accent, soft shadows. That is also what findmejob.xyz looked like before this system.

elevation.note: No shadows anywhere. Depth is value layering: paper, then film, then window, then mark. A drop shadow would make the film float above the worktop instead of resting on it.

motion.signature: The mark scheme drawing itself: five weight bars filling 70ms apart with their figures arriving behind them.
motion.reducedMotion: The reveal hook checks prefers-reduced-motion and never arms; every element renders finished. Colour feedback that confirms an action survives, movement does not.

rules: The Mark Rule. Chinagraph is a mark, never a surface carrying text — it fails AA as a text ground at 3.71:1.
The Straight Stroke Rule. The mark is a stroke along an edge. No rings, circles or drawn-on loops.
The Two Meanings Rule. Colour carries meaning in exactly two places: the mark, and the score bands.
The Flat Sheet Rule. If something must read as raised, change its value, not add a shadow.
Square corners everywhere. border-radius is 0 across the whole system.
The Imagery Rule. Type is a primary material at the scale of pictures, never introduced by a kicker.
